level_A_pre_estimand.reading: a crossing is a claim whose ELIGIBILITY flipped; zero crossings means the change reaches the equivalence topology through membership composition only, never through eligibility

level_B_final_restriction_equivalent.scope: the final restriction-equivalent claim universe — the multiplicity surface capability and inference actually run on

invariant_1.statement: support equality is not membership equality

invariant_2.statement: restriction-equivalence rebuilt from corrected memberships; representative, alias relation, merge relation and final order are never carried forward
invariant_2.note: corrected equivalence_class_id, representative and alias sets come from the corrected enumeration; final signatures come from the corrected overlap-restricted memberships; no old label is read on the corrected path
